scope: Compressor catalogue displacement: per-protocol regressions (diagnostic) and per-basis physical normalization (issue #86)

ASHRAE_50Hz_fixed_single.description: Fixed-speed single-rotary compressor at 50 Hz supply, ASHRAE-type rating point

ARI_60Hz_variable_twin.description: DC inverter twin-rotary compressor at 60 Hz published test frequency, ARI rating point
ARI_60Hz_variable_twin.speed_basis: DC inverter test frequency as published; not measured shaft speed

ASHRAE_T_60rps_variable_twin.description: DC inverter twin-rotary compressor at 60 rps published performance speed, ASRE-T rating point (return gas 35 C)
ASHRAE_T_60rps_variable_twin.speed_basis: DC inverter test frequency as published; not measured shaft speed

selection: Family-balanced fits; nested leave-one-family-out. Inner simplest within2% best RMSE. Secondary nested model-token-group holdout prevents suffix variants leaking.
